raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Problem and fix

OffloaderV2 copies a CPU-offloaded parameter with `Tensor.to("cuda")`, producing a new tensor without the source parameter's `is_shuffled` attribute. Aiter MoE consumers use that flag to select the preshuffled weight layout. Preserve a true flag on the device copy; absent/false flags retain the existing behavior.

The implementation is scoped to OffloaderV2 `cpu` mode. Its `create_device_tensor` method has the same AST as the original deployed October 15 patch after normalizing the local variable name (`t` versus `output`). It adds no new kernel or stream behavior.

## Validation

- Archived MI355X GLM-5.2-MXFP4 full-model runs `ofs0c`, `ofg3c`, and `ofg2c` used offload groups 8, 3 and 2 with this attribute-preservation patch. Rechecked their raw `results.jsonl.gz` records: **23/23 passed in each run**. The ledger explicitly records simulated acceptance off for `ofs0c`; performance runs were recorded separately. There was no unpatched end-to-end control, so these are deployment/correctness observations, not an isolated performance comparison.
- At this PR's actual head `43dec26`, the real MI355X onload/forward regression passed: **1 test + 3 subtests**, PyTorch 2.9.1+ROCm 7.2. It covers real pinned CPU copies, alternate-stream onload, two forward cycles and host-parameter restoration for true/false/absent tags. [Execution evidence](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45484#issuecomment-6440222902).
- Current-main CPU regressions: **3 passed + 2 subtests**. Unpatched main: **2 expected failures, 1 control passed**. The tests exercise the actual forward wrapper as well as the copy boundary.
- Applicable local lint and upstream lint/title pass.

```bash
PYTHONPATH=python python -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/utils/test_offloader.py
PYTHONPATH=python python test/registered/model_loading/test_offloader_shuffled_weights.py
pre-commit run --files python/sglang/srt/utils/offloader.py test/registered/unit/utils/test_offloader.py test/registered/model_loading/test_offloader_shuffled_weights.py
```

## Review scope and remaining coverage

Ready for review based on the unchanged deployed behavior, current-main CPU regressions and hardware regression at this exact PR head. A further full-model rerun is not an author-side prerequisite for reviewing this narrow attribute-copy fix.

CUDA coverage is registered for CI and has not been executed locally. Maintainer-enabled CI and code review remain required; gated/skipped workflows are not passes. `shm_cpu` and `sharded_gpu` modes have a different lifecycle and are outside this fix. No throughput benefit or general stack-correctness claim is made: historical throughput used simulated acceptance, and unrelated PP-overlap/custom-all-reduce correctness issues remain separate.

files.patch:
@@ -424,7 +424,13 @@ def __init__(self, module, param_name):
         _move_param_to_cpu(self._param, pin_memory=True)
 
     def create_device_tensor(self):
-        return self._param.to("cuda", non_blocking=True)
+        output = self._param.to("cuda", non_blocking=True)
+        # `.to()` returns a fresh tensor without the parameter's Python attributes,
+        # but MoE kernels (e.g. aiter fused_moe) select the preshuffled weight layout
+        # via `is_shuffled` on the weight, so carry it over to the device copy.
+        if getattr(self._param, "is_shuffled", False):
+            output.is_shuffled = True
+        return output
 
 
 class _ShmCpuParamOffloader(_BaseParamOffloader):

@@ -0,0 +1,67 @@
+"""Exercise shuffled-weight metadata through real OffloaderV2 CPU onloads."""
+
+import unittest
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from sglang.srt.utils.offloader import _hook_module_forward_raw, _ModuleOffloader
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_amd_ci, register_cuda_ci
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=5, stage="base-b", runner_config="1-gpu-small")
+register_amd_ci(est_time=5, suite="stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd")
+
+
+class WeightConsumer(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, is_shuffled):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.weight = nn.Parameter(
+            torch.arange(8, dtype=torch.float32, device="cuda").reshape(2, 4),
+            requires_grad=False,
+        )
+        if is_shuffled is not None:
+            self.weight.is_shuffled = is_shuffled
+
+    def forward(self, inputs):
+        return self.weight @ inputs, getattr(self.weight, "is_shuffled", False)
+
+
+@unittest.skipUnless(torch.cuda.is_available(), "Requires a CUDA or ROCm device")
+class TestShuffledWeightOnload(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_onload_forward_and_host_parameter_restoration(self):
+        for is_shuffled in (True, False, None):
+            with self.subTest(is_shuffled=is_shuffled):
+                module = WeightConsumer(is_shuffled)
+                inputs = torch.arange(4, dtype=torch.float32, device="cuda")
+                expected, _ = module(inputs)
+                host_parameter = module.weight
+                module_offloader = _ModuleOffloader(
+                    mode="cpu",
+                    module=module,
+                    alt_stream=torch.cuda.Stream(),
+                    whitelist_param_names=["weight"],
+                    resident_parameter_ids=set(),
+                )
+                self.assertEqual(host_parameter.device.type, "cpu")
+                self.assertTrue(host_parameter.is_pinned())
+                _hook_module_forward_raw(
+                    module,
+                    on_forward_end=module_offloader.offload,
+                    get_parameter_and_buffer_dicts=(
+                        module_offloader.wait_and_get_device_tensors
+                    ),
+                )
+
+                for _ in range(2):
+                    module_offloader.start_onload()
+                    output, observed_tag = module(inputs)
+
+                    self.assertEqual(output.device.type, "cuda")
+                    self.assertEqual(observed_tag, bool(is_shuffled))
+                    torch.testing.assert_close(output, expected)
+                    self.assertIs(module.weight, host_parameter)
+                    self.assertEqual(module.weight.device.type, "cpu")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

@@ -0,0 +1,92 @@
+"""Unit tests for OffloaderV2 parameter offloaders — no server, no model loading."""
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+import unittest
+from unittest import mock
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from sglang.srt.utils import offloader
+
+_real_tensor_to = torch.Tensor.to
+_real_move_param_to_cpu = offloader._move_param_to_cpu
+
+
+def _fake_h2d(self, *args, **kwargs):
+    # Stands in for the host-to-device copy on CPU-only runners: like the real
+    # copy, it returns a new tensor that carries none of the source's attributes.
+    if args and args[0] == "cuda":
+        return _real_tensor_to(self.detach(), "cpu", copy=True)
+    return _real_tensor_to(self, *args, **kwargs)
+
+
+class TestCpuParamOffloader(unittest.TestCase):
+    def _make_offloader(self, is_shuffled):
+        module = nn.Module()
+        module.w13_weight = nn.Parameter(
+            torch.arange(8, dtype=torch.float32).reshape(2, 4), requires_grad=False
+        )
+        if is_shuffled is not None:
+            module.w13_weight.is_shuffled = is_shuffled
+        # Pinned memory needs an accelerator.
+        with mock.patch.object(
+            offloader,
+            "_move_param_to_cpu",
+            lambda param, pin_memory: _real_move_param_to_cpu(param, pin_memory=False),
+        ):
+            param_offloader = offloader._CpuParamOffloader(module, "w13_weight")
+        return module, param_offloader
+
+    def _create_device_tensor(self, param_offloader):
+        with mock.patch.object(torch.Tensor, "to", _fake_h2d):
+            return param_offloader.create_device_tensor()
+
+    def test_device_tensor_keeps_is_shuffled(self):
+        module, param_offloader = self._make_offloader(is_shuffled=True)
+
+        output = self._create_device_tensor(param_offloader)
+
+        self.assertIsNot(output, module.w13_weight)
+        self.assertTrue(getattr(output, "is_shuffled", False))
+        torch.testing.assert_close(output, module.w13_weight.data)
+
+    def test_device_tensor_without_is_shuffled(self):
+        for is_shuffled in (None, False):
+            with self.subTest(is_shuffled=is_shuffled):
+                _, param_offloader = self._make_offloader(is_shuffled=is_shuffled)
+
+                output = self._create_device_tensor(param_offloader)
+
+                self.assertFalse(getattr(output, "is_shuffled", False))
+
+    def test_forward_observes_tag_and_restores_host_parameter(self):
+        module, param_offloader = self._make_offloader(is_shuffled=True)
+        host_parameter = module.w13_weight
+        module.forward = lambda: (
+            module.w13_weight.sum(),
+            getattr(module.w13_weight, "is_shuffled", False),
+        )
+        on_forward_end = mock.Mock()
+        offloader._hook_module_forward_raw(
+            module,
+            on_forward_end=on_forward_end,
+            get_parameter_and_buffer_dicts=lambda: {
+                "w13_weight": self._create_device_tensor(param_offloader)
+            },
+        )
+
+        for _ in range(2):
+            value, is_shuffled = module()
+
+            self.assertTrue(is_shuffled)
+            torch.testing.assert_close(value, host_parameter.sum())
+            self.assertIs(module.w13_weight, host_parameter)
+        self.assertEqual(on_forward_end.call_count, 2)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
